depth_targets.title: Metric alarms (create, evaluate on every PutMetricData, state + history)
limitations: Static threshold alarms are evaluated live; anomaly-detection-band alarms are stored but never transition out of the initial state (no trained model).

Alarm actions (SNS/Lambda/Auto Scaling/EC2) are recorded in history as executed when the alarm transitions, but Vyomi does not actually publish to SNS or invoke the target — no notification is delivered.

depth_targets.title: Lambda / Auto Scaling / EC2 alarm actions
limitations: Only an SNS topic ARN notification action can be configured. Lambda, Auto Scaling and EC2 actions are not offered.

depth_targets.title: Anomaly detection bands
limitations: No anomaly model is trained; detectors stay PENDING_TRAINING and anomaly-threshold alarms never evaluate.

depth_targets.title: Automatic dashboards
limitations: Per-service automatic dashboards are an AWS-curated view over service metrics; Vyomi does not generate them.

depth_targets.title: Multi source query, cross-account Options and Source selection
limitations: Vyomi simulates a single account/region, so cross-account/cross-region metric source selection has nothing to select.

depth_targets.title: Subscription filters
limitations: A subscription filter is stored and matched against incoming events, but delivery to the destination (Lambda/Kinesis/Firehose) is kept as a counter — there is no cross-service fan-out.

depth_targets.title: Logs Insights queries (Logs Insights QL)
limitations: Supported: fields/display, filter (=, !=, >, <, >=, <=, like), sort, limit, stats count(*) [by field]. OpenSearch PPL and OpenSearch SQL query languages are not offered; Patterns and Visualization tabs are not computed.

depth_targets.title: Logs Insights Patterns and Visualization tabs
limitations: Pattern mining and chart aggregation over query results are not computed.

depth_targets.title: Live Tail
limitations: Vyomi polls FilterLogEvents on an interval instead of the real bidirectional Live Tail streaming protocol, so new events can take a few seconds to appear.

depth_targets.title: Log management Data sources tab
limitations: Vended log sources (data source onboarding across accounts/services) are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Log group data protection (sensitive data masking)
